opportunities.point: The company expects normalized EBITDA to stabilize at approximately INR 30,000 to INR 32,000 per ton on a steady state basis.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "excluding the exceptional tailwind of quarter three FY '26 and a confluence of one-time headwinds in quarter four FY '26, the management expects normalized EBITDA to stabilize at approximately INR32,000 to INR30,000 on a steady state basis." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The company expects copper volume growth to be in good double-digits with potential to go beyond 15%.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "So, on the growth side, I'd given my comment on this. And I mean, volumes depend upon many things but copper growth will be a good double-digit figure. It has potential to go beyond 15%." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The company has finalized around six acres of land for a proposed shift of plastic recycling operations to a dedicated plant.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "The company has finalized around six acres of land for proposed shift of plastic recycling operations from the existing copper and lead recycling plants." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The new dedicated plastic recycling unit will entail an estimated capex of around INR 15 crores.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "The new unit is targeted to become operational by quarter three financial year '27 and will entail an estimated capex of around INR15 crores, which will help us further strengthen our zero waste and circular economy model." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "The increasing focus on sustainability, circular economic practices, decarbonization, and supply-side constraint in the mined metals continue to strengthen the structural outlook for recycling business." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The company is utilizing around 65% of its installed copper capacity, close to 97% to 100% of lead capacity, and around 35% of aluminum capacity.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "So the copper, presently we are utilizing around 65% of the total installed capacity, while lead we are almost close to 97% to 100%, and aluminum is around 35% of the installed capacity." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The company has sourcing capabilities across more than 120 countries.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "From a sourcing perspective, we continue to maintain one of the strongest global procurement networks in the industry, with sourcing capabilities across more than 120 countries, and domestic sourcing also improving steadily, supported by India's evolving..." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: The business consumed cash from operations in the latest year.
Profit is growing while operating cash flow is shrinking - an earnings-quality gap.
threats.evidence: Net profit 211 -> 347 Cr (Mar 2026) but operating cash flow 28 Cr (Mar 2025) -> -570 Cr (Mar 2026)

threats.point: Inventory are stretching year on year.
The stock has drawn down sharply in the past.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Geopolitical disruptions from the Iran-Israel conflict impacted global shipping routes and increased logistics and fuel-related costs.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Secondly, the geopolitical disruptions arising from the Iran-Israel conflict impacted the global shipping routes and increasing logistic and fuel-related costs during March '26." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Dispatches for the Kuwait battery recycling venture have been temporarily delayed due to shipping route disruptions from the Iran-related geopolitical situation.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "However, due to disruption in shipping routes arising from Iran-related geopolitical situation, dispatches have been temporarily delayed." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: The company faced raw material supply constraints and container delays at Dubai port due to the geopolitical war.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Yes, it is because of the geopolitical war. There is a supply of the raw material has been constrained and a lot of containers got stuck in Dubai port." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Mar, Sep, Dec) are still in the cycle.

swot.verdict: Opportunities dominate the evidence (S26/W27/O28/T21), led by 'The company expects normalized EBITDA to stabilize at approximately INR 30,000 to INR 32,000 per ton on a steady state basis', so the case leans on things that are not in the reported numbers yet.
